mapper.insert: insert into research_project (user_id, project_type, title, level, start_time, has_company, company_name, sign_time, execution_period, expected_end_time, completion_doc_path, completion_doc_name, completion_doc_size, status, is_completed) values (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{level}, #{startTime}, #{hasCompany}, #{companyName}, #{signTime}, #{executionPeriod}, #{expectedEndTime}, #{completionDocPath}, #{completionDocName}, #{completionDocSize}, #{status}, #{isCompleted})
mapper.select: select rp.id, rp.user_id userId, rp.project_type type, rp.title, rp.status, rp.is_completed isCompleted, rp.level, rp.start_time startTime, rp.has_company hasCompany, rp.company_name companyName, rp.sign_time signTime, rp.execution_period executionPeriod, rp.expected_end_time expectedEndTime, rp.completion_doc_path completionDocPath, rp.completion_doc_name completionDocName, rp.completion_doc_size completionDocSize, rp.audit_user_id auditUserId, rp.audit_time auditTime, rp.audit_remark auditRemark, rp.create_time createTime, rp.update_time updateTime, rp.delete_flag deleteFlag, u.real_name userName, u.employee_id employeeId, u.phone phone, u.department department, u.email email from research_project rp left join users u on rp.user_id = u.id where rp.delete_flag = 0 and rp.user_id = #{userId} and rp.status = #{status} order by rp.create_time desc

select id, user_id userId, project_type type, title, status, is_completed isCompleted, level, start_time startTime, has_company hasCompany, company_name companyName, sign_time signTime, execution_period executionPeriod, expected_end_time expectedEndTime, completion_doc_path completionDocPath, completion_doc_name completionDocName, completion_doc_size completionDocSize, audit_user_id auditUserId, audit_time auditTime, audit_remark auditRemark, create_time createTime, update_time updateTime, delete_flag deleteFlag from research_project where id = #{id} and delete_flag = 0
